messages:
Alex K: Hey CS — quick draft idea: 'Fresh‑start priming playbook' for low‑touch/onboarding accounts that show early churn risk. Goal = 1‑page runbook + a short Slack snippet AMs can paste. Looking for succinct ops checklist (caching, batching, streaming) we can hand to customers and internal AMs.
Maria C: Love it. High‑level goals to call out: reduce 99p latency, avoid cold KV misses, and keep token spend predictable. Keep it customer‑facing and non-technical where possible. :+1:
Sam P: I’d split into 3 phases: 1) health check & signals, 2) light priming + edge cache, 3) adaptive batching + graceful stream degradation. Each phase = 3 bullets max.
Beth L: Quick checklist items I use with accounts: pre-warm with 3 synthetic starter prompts, edge cache templates (TTL = 30m), per-tenant KV prefix to avoid cross-tenant pollution, and a fallback route to a smaller model during surges. Add a one-liner on why each helps.
Alex K: Snippet for AMs to run basic checks (pasteable):
```bash
# verify tenant health signals
/tenant-health check <TENANT_ID>
# fire a tiny warmup to populate KV cache
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-small","prompt":"#tenant_warmup
Hello!
"}'
```
Maria C: Add streaming client guidance: use early‑ack for UI readiness, send small initial chunk then stream remainder; client reconnect backoff = exponential, start 1s, cap 30s. Also note: prefer chunked responses for slow networks.
Sam P: Batching defaults I recommend to customers: max_batch_size=16, max_latency_ms=50. Telemetry: tag requests with `cs.priming=true` and `cs.phase=warmup|steady`. If we see >5% queue drops, reduce batch size or bump dedicated capacity.
Beth L: Renewal signal to include in the playbook: if `onboarding_success_rate < 60%` after 7 days OR average first‑week latency > 1.5s -> flag renewal_risk and trigger a handoff call template. Keep the triggering logic explicit so AMs can automate.
Alex K: Quick email template for AMs (one paragraph):
"Hi <Name>, we ran a lightweight priming flow and enabled short‑term edge caching to improve responsiveness while you ramp. If you notice any slow renders or errors, reply and we’ll jump on a 20‑minute call to tune batching and routing. — <AM name>"
cs-bot: Created stub doc at https://redwood.internal/ops/cs/fresh-start-priming-playbook (edit and link final 1‑pager here).
Maria C: I'll convert this into the 1‑pager and a short pasteable Slack snippet for AMs. Action items: Sam = add dashboard tiles for cs.priming telemetry, Beth = write the handoff email + playbook steps, Alex = run one pilot tenant this week and report metrics by Fri.
Sam P: On it — I’ll add a small graph showing latency before/after prewarm and a simple alert when KV misses > 15%.
Beth L: Drafting the email now and will drop in the doc.
Alex K: Thanks team :rocket: Will schedule a 15m sync if we need to iterate on wording.
